question: Where was the India Open Badminton Super 750 tournament held in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **India Open 2025**, officially sanctioned by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**, was held in **New Delhi**.
 
• The tournament took place at the prestigious **K. D. Jadhav Indoor Hall**, located within the **Indira Gandhi Sports Complex**, which is a premier venue for international indoor sports in **India**.
 
• Scheduled from **January 21 to January 26, 2025**, the event is a part of the **BWF World Tour** circuit.
 
• It is classified as a **Super 750** tournament, representing the second-highest level of the **BWF World Tour**, just below the Super 1000 and the World Tour Finals.
 
• The event attracts the world's elite badminton players across five categories: **Men's Singles**, **Women's Singles**, **Men's Doubles**, **Women's Doubles**, and **Mixed Doubles**.
 
• Hence, the correct answer
